crossRefs.note: Now king Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites…
Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved…
The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.
Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

people.line: Valley where Delilah lived, Samson's downfall occurred

translations.web: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
translations.bsb: Some time later, Samson fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
